produces.meaning: the design council ran at build time, before any UI code was written

evidence.why: cupertino-council writes NOTHING. It produces a Council Brief, a Tension Log, a Design Identity sentence and then UI code -- all in conversation. Its only scripts are stdin-to-exit-code validators. cupertino has a real flag writer (scripts/state.py set <flag>), but no skill on the council path invokes it.
